strings.jp:
焔帝ガルカーサ!
このデュラン、勝負を挑む!
strings.en:
Flame Emperor Gulcasa!
I, Durant, challenge you!

strings.jp:
貴様ら雑魚には用は無い!
そこをどけ!
strings.en:
I have no use for small fry!
Out of my way!

As expected of the
Flame Emperor...

strings.jp: 雑魚に用は無いと言ったはずだ!
strings.en:
I told you I have
no use for small fry!

strings.jp:
何だとッ……!?
王国の騎士ごときに…
strings.en:
What...!? To a mere
knight of the Kingdom...

strings.jp:
王国騎士の力…
その目に焼き付けてもらおう!
strings.en:
The might of royal knights...
Burn it into your eyes!
